sme_context:
Asset Class: Chiller

1. Component: Compressor

Failure Mode: Compressor fails to compress refrigerant
Failure Reason: Dirty or worn-out compressor valves, insufficient lubrication, or a seized compressor motor
Failure Code: CC-01
Degradation Mechanism: Aging, lack of maintenance, or operating the chiller outside of its specified parameters can cause the compressor to fail.
Severity: High - A compressor failure can cause a complete shutdown of the chiller, leading to a significant loss of cooling capacity.
Ability to Detect: Medium - While some compressor issues can be detected through regular maintenance and performance monitoring, others may only become apparent once the compressor has already failed.

2. Component: Condenser

Failure Mode: Leak in the condenser
Failure Reason: Corrosion, vibration, or improper installation
Failure Code: CD-01
Degradation Mechanism: A leak in the condenser can be caused by a variety of factors, including corrosion from dirty or untreated water, vibration from the compressor, or improper installation of the condenser.
Severity: Medium - A leak in the condenser can reduce the cooling capacity of the chiller and increase energy consumption.
Ability to Detect: High - Leaks in the condenser can typically be detected through regular inspections and performance monitoring.

3. Component: Evaporator

Failure Mode: Frost build-up on the evaporator
Failure Reason: Low refrigerant charge, dirty or clogged filters, or improper refrigerant flow
Failure Code: CE-01
Degradation Mechanism: Frost build-up on the evaporator can be caused by a variety of factors, including a low refrigerant charge, dirty or clogged filters, or improper refrigerant flow.
Severity: Medium - Frost build-up on the evaporator can reduce the cooling capacity of the chiller and increase energy consumption.
Ability to Detect: High - Frost build-up on the evaporator can typically be detected through regular inspections and performance monitoring.

4. Component: Control System

Failure Mode: Control system failure
